message.content:
Here’s a quick roundup of some of the most highly regarded crime‑thriller films released in 2020:

| # | Title | Director | Key Highlights |
|---|-------|----------|----------------|
| 1 | **"Tenet"** | Christopher Nolan | A mind‑bending espionage thriller that blends time‑travel mechanics with high‑stakes action. |
| 2 | **"The Gentlemen"** | Guy Ritchie | A stylish British gangster caper featuring an ensemble cast and Ritchie’s signature rapid dialogue. |
| 3 | **"The Irishman"** | Martin Scorsese | A sprawling mob saga that uses de-aging tech to follow Frank Sheeran’s life over decades. |
| 4 | **"The Trial of the Chicago 7"** | Aaron Sorkin | Though more courtroom drama, it’s a tense political thriller about the 1969 trial of anti‑war activists. |
| 5 | **"The Hunt"** | Thomas Vinterberg | A psychological thriller that follows a man falsely accused of child abuse, exploring paranoia and social media hysteria. |

These films were praised for their storytelling, performances, and technical achievements, making them standout entries in the crime‑thriller genre for 2020.
